report_topic: Public Health Infrastructure and Management of Health Services
observations_summary: The audit found significant deficiencies in human resources (41.87% overall shortfall), inadequate healthcare infrastructure (113 works not started, 69 STPs delayed by 19-22 months), and issues with drug and equipment management (341.59 lakh quantities of drugs expired, 149 ventilators non-functional). Regulatory mechanisms were also weak, with many clinical establishments operating without proper registration or inspections.
